messages:
sophia (Sales): Hey @matt @kevin — vendor risk wants our SOC 2 report and a short bridge letter for their procurement check. POC with Acme next Wed, can we get temporary access to the report behind an NDA? timeline is tight.

matt (Legal): We can provide the SOC 2 report under an NDA + bridge ack. Need customer to sign our standard mutual NDA. Once signed we can grant S3 access or a presigned URL. Bridge letter is a 1-pager. I can draft. :+1:

kevin (Infra): I can generate a presigned S3 URL for the report for a limited window (72h). Need the NDA scan uploaded to Legal's Jira or dropbox link to validate. Also can set IP allowlist if they request.

anita (Security): Couple of risk notes: (1) we redact internal employee PII from the report; (2) bridge letter must not assert future SOC 2 status — just current coverage and scope. If customer asks for CAIQ/SIG extracts, we can provide a completed CAIQ snapshot but we prefer a redacted export.

sophia (Sales): Thanks. Customer prefers a short legal note rather than a full NDA exchange if possible — can we do an expedited one-way ack? they are constrained by procurement.

matt (Legal): We avoid one-way unilateral acknowledgements for reports containing operational details. However we can offer a short "interim access agreement" template: a short mutual NDA with limited term and limited use clause. Will ping legal-bot to attach template.

legal-bot: Attached interim_nnda_v2.pdf (link: https://legal.redwood.internal/interim_nnda_v2.pdf)

kevin (Infra): Once legal confirms, I can run this command to create a presigned URL:

```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-soc2-prod/reports/2024-08-soc2.pdf --expires-in 259200
```

Will return the URL and I can expire it early if needed. Also can require TLS + referer restrictions if they host behind a corp portal.

anita (Security): I'll review the bridge wording. Quick checklist for the letter: scope of SOC 2 (CC1-CC3 etc), report period, redaction statement, non-reliance clause, and contact for evidence questions. Keep it under 300 words.

sophia (Sales): ETA on draft + URL? customer needs proof of compliance to close the POC contract.

matt (Legal): I'll drop a draft in 2 business hours into this thread and attach the NDA link. After Sophia confirms, Kevin can provision access.

kevin (Infra): FYI I can have the URL ready in under 1 hour after I get a signed copy or confirmation from Legal.

sophia (Sales): Perfect — will tell the customer: interim NDA then 72h access to redacted SOC 2 via presigned URL. I'll follow up once they sign. :pray:
